access_token.description: The access token you can use to authenticate against Bluecore’s API.

expires_in.description: The number of seconds until the access_token expires. New tokens are active for 86,400 seconds (24 hours). When your access token expires, you can request a new access token.

scope.description: Space-delimited string of permissions that the access token has. The format is `resource:verb`. For example, `customers:write` grants write access to the Customers API.
